patch_description: Two targeted improvements: (1) per the recommendation, random Gaussian starts cluster and waste optimization trials. Preprocess the 16 random starts with ~150 iterations of projected gradient descent minimizing sum of inverse-square distances (Coulomb-like repulsion), recentering/rescaling each step — this spreads them quasi-uniformly into diverse new basins before annealing, at low cost. (2) Add a final intensive polish stage on the overall best configuration: several rounds of small random jitter followed by the exact-ratio L-BFGS-B, escaping kink stalls of the nonsmooth (dmin/dmax)^2 objective to squeeze out additional score beyond the reference ratio 1/4.1658.
